title: Platina - Live in Yerevan: rig plan with the 22 light scenes
what: v1.1: 22 scenes (Platina | Live in Yerevan, stage LIGHT scenes, merged spec (spine design A, grafts from design B))

pictures.front: plot-front.png (11-10 light plot, front view, 1654x1170 px)
pictures.top: plot-top.png (11-10 light plot, top view, 1654x1170 px)
pictures.side: plot-side.png (11-10 light plot, side view, 1654x1170 px)

schema: the MOXIR rig schema (moxir-v2-12-2026-10-17.json: fixtures[{id,type,p,r,angle_rad,dmx,status}] + solids[{id,name,kind,p,r,s}]) plus: per item status (measured / from-plan-words / PROPOSED), source, profile (stand-in), size_m, group (the patch plan's select.group)
frame: metres, Y up from the AUDIENCE floor (stage deck top at y = 0.6), +x = the audience's right, +z toward the audience, z = 0 the screen's middle plane, x = 0 the axis of the 8 pixel towers. Rotation three.js Euler XYZ radians: an unrotated beam points -Y (down); [pi,0,0] points up; [-pi/2,0,0] points +z. p = the middle of the lamp body; box solids base-anchored (p.y = the base), truss p = the middle of the section.
method: scripts/place/platina_rig.py: grid pitch per picture from the light-grey lines; one square = 1 m, proved on standard parts (see calibration); colour blobs and dark-line edges against the grid; numbers rounded to 1 cm (a drawing px is 1.0-1.3 cm, the symbols are split by drawn lines: positions are good to about 0.05 m).

calibration.reading: truss 4 x 2 m = 8.0; 3 stacked bars = 3.0; screen 4.0 x 2.5; the drawn person 1.74 m: all within 0.1 m of 1 m per square in all three views

kit_note: counts of the offer (rental list scripts/rigbuild/rentals/platina-2026-11-11.json, offer of 2026-11-11); no prices are kept here

screen.status: measured from the drawing, NOT confirmed by the Platina side (ask the screen crew)

axis_note.why: the plot is not exactly symmetric: the screen and the trusses sit 0.03-0.1 m left of the tower axis; kept as drawn

profiles.library: src/rigbuild/types/library (UP-*, EXT-*) and scripts/place/fixtures/fixtures.json kinds; none of the five Platina types has its own profile

cp-aleda-beye-k10.why: the real lamp: zoom 4-60 deg, output from its manual

draw.basis: ASSUMED: renderer class values for a wash, not maker data

photometry.basis: EXACT total output (manual, technical data: B-EYE K10 5500 lumens); candela is DERIVED as a uniform cone of the unit's beam angle, an upper bound on axis

cp-hy-beye-k15.why: the real lamp; its output is not published in the papers held, body from the plot symbol

draw.basis: ASSUMED: renderer class values for a wash, not maker data

photometry.basis: ASSUMED: the K15 datasheet and manual state no lumen or lux figure, so the K10's 5500 lumens stand in; the real K15 is brighter

draw.basis: ASSUMED: renderer class values for a beam, not maker data

acme-pixel-line-ip.why: the real bar: the datasheet's 101 deg RGB figure; the bar is 1.0 x ~0.07 x ~0.11 m from the plot

draw.basis: ASSUMED: renderer class values for a bar, not maker data

looks.title: Work light
looks.intent: Plain white from the wash lamps and bars so crew can see; beams and everything else off.
looks.notes: Single trigger; hold_s 1800 is the crew window, not a show time.

looks.title: Doors, deep blue
looks.intent: Doors open to a nearly black room: only the six floor K15 glow deep blue, bars dark. The room is held dark on purpose.
looks.notes: Palette: deep blue #0a3ff0 from the deck grid-blue. Haze runs by hand (not a scene).

looks.title: Wait, one pool
looks.intent: Tension before he enters: everything dark except one narrow white column on his mark and a violet breath on the two centre towers.
looks.notes: Tower 4 and 5 are the inner pair on each side (x -4.49 and +4.47), ASSUMED to read as centre.

looks.title: Entry, one beam
looks.intent: His first step: only the centre beam, hard white, nothing else. No wash.
looks.notes: XP-16R white/open only.

looks.title: Magenta room
looks.intent: The whole room one colour, magenta, low and heavy; towers and floor carry it, the over-stage wash fills the haze. No beams.
looks.notes: Deck owner removed purple bars: here magenta is the whole room, not a purple bar look.

looks.title: White pillars
looks.intent: Seven over-stage beams drop straight down as white columns in the haze, the room around them magenta-dark: the beams are the architecture.
looks.notes: Beams stay at home aim (straight down); no head pattern, so no audience-eye risk (rule D).

looks.title: SILHOUETTE: BACKLIGHT
looks.intent: Front dark: K10 off. Backlight from the floor row K15 and the outer towers; background colour breathes magenta to ice-blue on the towers as the screen changes behind him.
looks.notes: K15 floor row at z 0.13 per rig-report.md items table.

looks.title: Red pressure
looks.intent: Hard verse: all red, verticals only. Towers red, floor red low, five beams as a white X from above. One colour, no wash from the front.
looks.notes: Red is a slow breathe at 50 bpm, no flash (rule A). heads on the XP-16R need the kinds check fixed in looks_from_scenes (ASSUMED).

looks.title: VERSE: WORDS RED
looks.intent: Hard verse with words on screen in #ff1a1a: floor K15 and tower bars go red to meet the words, K10 washes drop to near dark, white beams cut through the red.
looks.notes: No red flash: breathe 35 bpm, rule A.

looks.title: Freeze before the drop
looks.intent: Everything falls to nothing in half a second and holds: one cold white beam on him and a dim white floor. No motion. Screen freezes with it.
looks.notes: Reusable cue: the operator fires it before each of the three drops. No flash.

looks.title: Drop hit, white
looks.intent: One hit: all wash lamps, bars and beams white for a moment, then it is the next scene. A single hit, no repeat.
looks.notes: Reusable cue, hold 1.5 s total, then straight into the drop colour. Wash cap 0.8.

looks.title: Drop A, magenta flood
looks.intent: Drop one: the wash lamps flood magenta full, towers magenta, floor magenta. A wall of colour from above.
looks.notes: Drop A is a flood from above; drops B and C differ in structure on purpose.

looks.title: Ice line
looks.intent: Cool verse: only the towers, thin ice-blue, and a deep blue floor. Dark above.
looks.notes: Moving mode sine on y: a slow rise through the towers, 30 bpm.

looks.title: VERSE: GLITCH GREY
looks.intent: Screen is grey/black glitch with red text: lights go to white and grey, only the words colour red on two towers; beams straight down.
looks.notes: Sparkle at 90 bpm on bars: ASSUMED under 3 flashes per s per bar.

looks.title: Slow part, one voice
looks.intent: The quiet song: one narrow white column on him, floor violet at a whisper, the centre towers barely lit. Nothing else.
looks.notes: No CO2 here (rule E). Long hold on purpose.

looks.title: Build, rising ice
looks.intent: The riser: the towers rise from nothing to full ice blue over 12 seconds; wash joins late.
looks.notes: Short scene; the fade_s is the build, hold_s 6 is the total on time at full.

looks.title: Drop B, red verticals
looks.intent: Drop two: wash dark, towers red hard, a white X of five beams. The drop is narrow and vertical, not a flood.
looks.notes: Chase 90 bpm, under 3 per second (rule A); no large red flashing. heads kinds check ASSUMED fixed.

looks.title: Drop C, white cathedral
looks.intent: Drop three: all twelve beams drop white as columns, towers ice then white alternating by tower, wash dark. A cathedral of beams.
looks.notes: Beams 8-12 aim down from the audience-side truss, PROPOSED places (rig-report). Pingpong 60 bpm, no flash.

looks.title: Encore wall
looks.intent: Final push: wash magenta, towers alternate magenta and ice by tower, all twelve beams wide.
looks.notes: Pump 72 bpm, under 3 per second.

looks.title: Bow, white thanks
looks.intent: All white, face-lit from above and from the floor, beams off so no one is dazzled. His face is visible.
looks.notes: Beams off, not tilted (the tilt can not be proven).

looks.title: Blackout
looks.intent: Instant dark. One part at level zero stands for all.
looks.notes: All parts off; hazers not touched.

looks.title: House
looks.intent: Walk-out: plain white, half level from the over-stage wash. Nothing else.
looks.notes: Deck owner removed amber: plain white.
